sources.title: THC Cannabis Plant Science Source Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project-controlled plant-science source map; supports architecture and cross-links, but not final standalone proof.

sources.title: THC Cultivation SOP Source Materials Packet v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Project-controlled operational source map for measurement, records, safety, and QA boundaries.

sources.title: BIPM — The International System of Units (SI Brochure), 9th edition, version 4.01, June 2026
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative SI units, symbols, prefixes, quantities, and writing conventions.

sources.title: JCGM 200 — International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM)
sources.useAndLimitation: Authoritative vocabulary for measurement, calibration, verification, accuracy, precision, uncertainty, and traceability.

sources.title: JCGM 100 — Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement (GUM)
sources.useAndLimitation: General framework for evaluating and reporting measurement uncertainty; current supplements and amendments require release review.

sources.title: NIST — Metrological Traceability
sources.useAndLimitation: Explains that traceability is a property of a measurement result through a documented unbroken calibration chain, with each link contributing uncertainty.

sources.title: NIST Technical Note 1297 — Guidelines for Evaluating and Expressing the Uncertainty of NIST Measurement Results
sources.useAndLimitation: Practical uncertainty vocabulary, components, combination, coverage, and reporting.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 — General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories
sources.useAndLimitation: Laboratory competence, impartiality, method control, equipment, traceability, sampling, reporting, and nonconforming work; standard text and current confirmation status require controlled access.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods
sources.useAndLimitation: Primary reference for experimental design, measurement process characterization, control charts, uncertainty, regression, and statistical graphics.

sources.title: Wilkinson et al. 2016 — The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
sources.useAndLimitation: Findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable data principles; FAIR does not automatically mean open or high quality.

sources.title: MIAPPE — Minimum Information About a Plant Phenotyping Experiment
sources.useAndLimitation: Plant-phenotyping metadata, biological material, environment, experimental design, observations, and data reporting.

sources.title: Papoutsoglou et al. 2020 — Enabling reusability of plant phenomic datasets with MIAPPE 1.1
sources.useAndLimitation: Plant experiment and phenotyping reporting standard with machine-readable context.

sources.title: DataCite Metadata Schema
sources.useAndLimitation: Persistent identifiers, creators, versions, related identifiers, dates, resource types, and citation metadata.

sources.title: Crossref — Crossmark
sources.useAndLimitation: Publisher-maintained record of corrections, retractions, updates, and current document status.

sources.title: NLM — Errata, retractions, and other linked publication notices in PubMed
sources.useAndLimitation: Publication-status controls and linked notices; database records must be checked at use and release.

sources.title: W3C PROV-O — The PROV Ontology
sources.useAndLimitation: Machine-readable provenance relationships among entities, activities, agents, derivations, and revisions.

sources.title: NIST — Biological and chemical data provenance guidance and research
sources.useAndLimitation: Provenance concepts for samples, methods, transformations, datasets, and analysis chains.

sources.title: ISO 5725 series — Accuracy (trueness and precision) of measurement methods and results
sources.useAndLimitation: Repeatability, reproducibility, trueness, precision, and method-performance concepts; current parts require controlled access and version review.

sources.title: JCGM 106 — The role of measurement uncertainty in conformity assessment
sources.useAndLimitation: Decision rules, guard bands, acceptance limits, and uncertainty in pass/fail decisions.

sources.title: ASTM Committee D37 on Cannabis
sources.useAndLimitation: Current consensus standards and work items for cannabis sampling, testing, quality, security, and processing; exact edition and applicability must be verified.

sources.title: AOAC INTERNATIONAL — Cannabis Analytical Science Program
sources.useAndLimitation: Validated-method and performance-requirement context for cannabinoids, contaminants, and cannabis matrices; method scope must be checked.

sources.title: NIST Cannabis Quality Assurance Program and Reference Materials
sources.useAndLimitation: Interlaboratory comparison and reference-material context for cannabis and hemp measurements.

sources.title: ASTM and instrument-manufacturer water-activity method controls
sources.useAndLimitation: Sample equilibration, instrument verification, temperature, cleanliness, and device-specific limitations.

sources.title: USDA NRCS — National Engineering Handbook, irrigation and water-management standards
sources.useAndLimitation: Measurement and record concepts for irrigation flow, pressure, application, distribution, and water management.

sources.title: APHA/AWWA/WEF — Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater
sources.useAndLimitation: Method-controlled water sampling and analysis context; exact edition and method access require review.

sources.title: EPA — Quality System and Quality Assurance Project Plans
sources.useAndLimitation: Data-quality objectives, sampling design, QA/QC, documentation, validation, and corrective action.

sources.title: FDA — Investigating Out-of-Specification Test Results for Pharmaceutical Production
sources.useAndLimitation: Structured investigation concepts for suspect results, laboratory review, production review, and scientifically justified conclusions; product-regulatory scope differs.

sources.title: ICH Q9(R1) — Quality Risk Management
sources.useAndLimitation: Risk-based decision, hazard, probability, severity, detectability, control, communication, and review concepts; pharmaceutical scope requires bounded transfer.

sources.title: ISO 9001:2015 — Quality management systems
sources.useAndLimitation: Documented process, competence, monitoring, nonconformity, corrective action, and continual improvement concepts; certification is not required for educational use.

sources.title: Montgomery — Design and Analysis of Experiments
sources.useAndLimitation: General experimental-design reference for randomization, replication, blocking, factorials, interactions, and model checking.

sources.title: Lazic 2010 — The problem of pseudoreplication in neuroscientific studies
sources.useAndLimitation: Clear treatment of experimental units, technical replicates, and invalid inflation of sample size; transfer as general design principle.

sources.title: Gelman and Hill — Data Analysis Using Regression and Multilevel/Hierarchical Models
sources.useAndLimitation: Confounding, partial pooling, repeated measures, multilevel data, and model-based interpretation.

sources.title: THC Cannabis Encyclopedia Volumes 01–20 controlled manuscripts
sources.useAndLimitation: Internal examples of morphology, environment, irrigation, diagnostic, postharvest, breeding, and evidence-limit records.

sources.title: THC Master Content Compilation and Merge Register v1.0
sources.useAndLimitation: Permanent IDs, completion definitions, review gates, source hierarchy, visual requirements, page package, and release-state separation.
